family.tagline: Two parents, two small children and one Companion Core in a yellow house.
family.story: Hannah keeps the books for small local businesses at the dining table. Callum is at home with Alfie, who is one, and Nell, seven, asks her questions upstairs. One Companion Core holds the invoices, the photos and the shopping list.

companion.name: Biscotti
companion.job: Drafts payment reminders to Hannah's clients from the details she gives it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Hannah reads and sends every message herself.

companion.name: Mallow
companion.job: Drafts the invitations and notes Callum sends to family and friends.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Callum reads every message and sends it himself.

popup.title: Callum brings the Core inside
popup.body: Callum climbs the front steps with a parcel under one arm and Alfie on the other. It holds the new Companion Core.

popup.title: Nell reads the guide aloud
popup.body: Inside are the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. Nell reads the guide aloud while Hannah lifts out the Core.

popup.title: Nell presses the button
popup.body: Hannah plugs it in and Nell presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Hannah joins it from her phone
popup.body: Hannah opens the Wi-Fi settings on her phone and joins the Core's own network. Then she chooses the home network.

popup.title: The family picks its first apps
popup.body: In the Companion Hub store, Hannah picks Hermes, and the family adds Paperless-ngx and KitchenOwl. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: an agent that runs on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Biscotti says hello
popup.body: Hannah messages the agent she named Biscotti, and Biscotti answers from the Core in the living room.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: hannah
say.text: Hello, Hannah. I am Biscotti. Where shall we begin?

beats.capability: a family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals

popup.title: Monday coffee settles the week
popup.body: Over Monday coffee on the sofa, Hannah and Callum sort the week. Yuvomi gives the household one calendar and one task board, so both parents see the same plans.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos

popup.title: Alfie walks to the loveseat
popup.body: Alfie takes his first steps across the rug while Callum films. The clip backs up to Immich on the Core, not to a photo cloud.

beats.capability: merge, split, compress and convert PDFs on your own Core

popup.title: Hannah splits a year into months
popup.body: While Alfie naps in the crib, Hannah splits a client's bank statements into months. Stirling-PDF cuts the file on the Core, so she can send just one month.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner for the household

popup.title: Nell calls out bananas
popup.body: At the breakfast bar, Nell calls out for bananas, and Callum adds them. Everyone at home adds to the same KitchenOwl list, kept on the Core.

beats.capability: store every password in a vault you host; works with the Bitwarden apps

popup.title: Hannah finds the dentist's password
popup.body: Callum cannot remember the password for the dentist's website. Hannah finds it in the family's VaultWarden vault on the Core, through the Bitwarden apps on her phone.

beats.capability: an agent that runs on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Mallow drafts, Callum sends
popup.body: While the pasta water heats, Callum tells Mallow the plan for Sunday lunch. Mallow drafts the invitation to his parents, and Callum reads it and sends it himself.

say.speaker: callum
say.text: Here is the invitation. Please read it before you send it.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner for the household

popup.title: Alfie's first foods get a page
popup.body: Callum saves a mashed carrot recipe for Alfie in KitchenOwl and adds it to the week's meals. Then he adds the carrots to the shared list for whoever shops next.

beats.capability: invoicing, expenses, customers and profit and loss for a small business

popup.title: Hannah invoices the bakery
popup.body: Hannah keeps books for small shops. At the trestle table she raises her invoice to a bakery client, in Akaunting on the Core.

beats.capability: an agent that runs on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Biscotti drafts three reminders
popup.body: Three clients are late paying. Hannah gives Biscotti the amounts, and Biscotti drafts a reminder for each. Hannah reads them and sends each herself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: hannah
say.text: The reminders are drafted. Please check each amount, then send them.

beats.capability: scan and file your paperwork; it reads every page, tags it and makes it searchable

popup.title: The missing receipt turns up
popup.body: Hannah needs a florist's receipt, and Callum finds it by searching the shop's name in Paperless-ngx. He scanned it on Tuesday, and the scans stay on the Core by default.

beats.capability: your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core, synced to your devices

popup.title: A client asks for a month
popup.body: A client asks for last March's statements again. Hannah opens the client's Nextcloud folder. The split months sit in order on the Core, not in a rented drive.

beats.capability: the LibreOffice suite in your browser

popup.title: Hannah writes while Nell colours
popup.body: Nell colours at the trestle table while Hannah writes a client's quarterly summary in LibreOffice. The draft is a file on the Core until Hannah sends it.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: Nell finds the first strawberry
popup.body: On Saturday, Nell finds the first strawberry in the raised bed. Callum photographs it and dates it in HortusFox, whose plant journal sits on the Core.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: Callum gives the greenhouse a rule
popup.body: On warm mornings the greenhouse heats up, so Callum sets a rule: its fan starts at ten. Home Assistant runs the rule from the Core and needs no cloud account.

beats.capability: turn text into natural speech on your own Core

popup.title: Nell hears her spelling words
popup.body: Nell has a card of spelling words for Friday. Callum types each into Kokoro, which makes the speech on the Core, and Nell says every word back.

beats.capability: read ebooks in your browser; your library lives on your Core

popup.title: Nell reads to her teddy bear
popup.body: On Sunday morning, Nell reads a chapter to her teddy bear. Koodo Reader keeps the family's ebooks on the Core, and it saves her place in the chapter.

beats.capability: stream your own music collection to any device

popup.title: Nell picks Alfie's nap song
popup.body: Before Alfie's nap, Nell picks a song and Callum plays it beside the crib. Navidrome sends the family's own music from the Core to Callum's phone.

popup.title: A yellow house with one Core
popup.body: Hannah's books, Nell's questions and Alfie's first steps share one Companion Core in the yellow house.

closing.body: Your invoices, photos, shopping lists and family books can sit on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: Hannah keeps books for small clients: the Akaunting beat gives no accounting, tax or legal advice (catalog caveat). No beat presents anyone as a customer.
This house has no office, no study and no TV. Hannah sits at the Dining Room trestle table; the media beat at the couch is Immich; no beat says TV or screen.
Alfie is a baby with no archetype and no companion. The validator wants one beat for any member under 13, so kids-lullaby carries member alfie; Callum acts in it.
The Living Room has a crib, a sofa and a loveseat (couch nth 0 and 1). The Nursery crib is crib in kids nth 0; Playroom is also a kids room, so rooms in kids nth 2 is the Nursery.
Both companions are Hermes. The chat-service note rides on ftue-hello. Hannah and Callum read and send every message themselves. Companion Memory is not named.
The greenhouse has no anchor role of its own; garden-fan uses the garden bed nearest it (nth 4). HortusFox and Home Assistant both have QA screenshots; no review items expected.
